up: Retrieve exact IC50 values in nM (standard_relation = '=' and standard_units = 'nM') for compounds tested against human mTOR kinase. Return the ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), PubMed ID or DOI (COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi), assay description (assays.description), and target details (target_dictionary.pref_name, target_dictionary.organism). Filter for human targets (target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens') where the target name contains 'mTOR' or 'Mechanistic target of rapamycin'. Join activities to assays, docs, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND (td.pref_name LIKE '%mTOR%' OR td.pref_name LIKE '%Mechanistic target of rapamycin%')
